desc: The Minimus pierces the shadows with the right amount of light — 13 preset outputs up to a max of 300 lumens — precisely where you need it, thanks to its angle-adjustable LED housing. Its high-performance LED with a faceted MaxVision® reflector creates a wide, smooth beam optimized to your field of vision, and its pushbutton On/Off switch and variable-light output dial permit one-handed adjustment from 5 to 300 lumens
